#1.4
```{r}
df <- data.frame(name = state.name, 
                X = state.center$x,

head(df)
```

```{r}
# Geographic Coordinate System (GCS)
(df_sf_gcs = st_as_sf(df, 
                      coords = c("X", "Y"), 
                      crs = 4269))
```
```{r}
library(readr)
cities <- read_csv("data/uscities.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(eqdc)
```


```{r}
ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = df_sf_gcs) + 
  coord_sf(datum = st_crs(df_sf_gcs)) +
  theme_linedraw()
```

```{r}
(df_sf_pcs = st_transform(df_sf_gcs, 5070))
```

```{r}
ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = df_sf_pcs) + 
  coord_sf(datum = st_crs(df_sf_pcs)) +
  theme_linedraw()
```

## Question 2
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(units)
library(flextable)

#2.1 
us_border <- states %>% 
  st_union() %>% 
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities %>% 
  mutate(dist_us_border_km = drop_units(set_units(st_distance(geometry, us_border), "km")))


top5_us_border <- cities %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(city, state_name, dist_us_border_km) %>%
  arrange(desc(dist_us_border_km)) %>%
  slice(1:5) 

cities %>%
  select(city, state_name, dist_us_border_km) %>%
  slice_max(dist_us_border_km, n = 5) %>%
  flextable()
```
#2.2
```{r}
state_borders <- states %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%
  st_combine()


cities <- cities %>%

    st_distance(geometry, state_borders), "km")))


top5_state_border <- cities %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(city, state_name, dist_state_border_km) %>%
  arrange(desc(dist_state_border_km)) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  flextable()

top5_state_border


```

## Question 3
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(gghighlight)


top10_cities <- cities %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  slice(1:10)


conus_bbox <- st_bbox(states)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "gray90", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = top10_cities, aes(size = population), color = "red") +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top10_cities,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(conus_bbox$xmin, conus_bbox$xmax),
           ylim = c(conus_bbox$ymin, conus_bbox$ymax),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Most Populous Cities in the USA",
       subtitle = "Zoomed on the Contiguous U.S.") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#3.2 
```{r}

us_border <- states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(dist_border_km = drop_units(set_units(
    st_distance(geometry, us_border), "km")))


farthest_border <- cities %>%
  slice_max(dist_border_km, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray60") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist_border_km), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Distance (km)") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest_border, color = "black", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest_border,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(conus_bbox$xmin, conus_bbox$xmax),
           ylim = c(conus_bbox$ymin, conus_bbox$ymax),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "USA Cities by Distance to National Border",
       subtitle = "Top 5 Cities Farthest from a National Border") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

state_borders <- states %>%
  st_combine() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(dist_state_km = drop_units(set_units(
    st_distance(geometry, state_borders), "km")))


farthest_state <- cities %>%
  slice_max(dist_state_km, n = 5)


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray60") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist_state_km), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Distance (km)") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest_state, color = "black", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest_state,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(conus_bbox$xmin, conus_bbox$xmax),
           ylim = c(conus_bbox$ymin, conus_bbox$ymax),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "USA Cities by Distance to Nearest State Border",
       subtitle = "Top 5 Cities Farthest from Any State Border") +
  theme_minimal()


```


#3.4
```{r}
cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(
    abs_diff_mex_can = abs(dist_mexico_km - dist_canada_km)
  )
equidistant_cities <- cities %>%
  filter(abs_diff_mex_can <= 100)

top_equidistant <- equidistant_cities %>%
  slice_max(population, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray60") +
  geom_sf(data = equidistant_cities, aes(color = abs_diff_mex_can), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "cividis", name = "Distance Δ (km)") +
  geom_sf(data = top_equidistant, color = "black", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top_equidistant,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(conus_bbox$xmin, conus_bbox$xmax),
           ylim = c(conus_bbox$ymin, conus_bbox$ymax),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Equidistant Cities from Mexico and Canada",
       subtitle = "Cities within 100 km of Equal Distance to Both Borders") +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Question 4

```{r}

cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(in_danger_zone = dist_border_km <= 160)


border_zone_stats <- cities %>%
  summarize(
    total_cities = n(),
    cities_in_zone = sum(in_danger_zone),
    pct_cities_in_zone = round((cities_in_zone / total_cities) * 100, 2),
    total_population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    population_in_zone = sum(population[in_danger_zone], na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_population_in_zone = round((population_in_zone / total_population) * 100, 2)
  )

border_zone_stats %>% flextable()

```
#Answer:63% of the U.S. population lives within 100 miles of a border. This aligns closely with the ACLU’s estimate that nearly two-thirds of Americans are affected by expanded federal search authority in this zone.

#4.2 + 4.3
```{r}
danger_cities <- cities %>%
  filter(dist_us_border_km <= 160)


top_city_by_state <- danger_cities %>%
  group_by(state_name) %>%
  slice_max(population, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "grey95", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = danger_cities, aes(color = population), size = 1) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred", name = "Population") +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top_city_by_state,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cities Within 100 Miles of U.S. Border",
    subtitle = "Most Populous City in Each State in the Danger Zone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-2000000, 2500000), ylim = c(0, 3300000))

```
